newsitem.title: USA: GTS Duratek sees Q4 processsing resumption.
newsitem.headline: GTS Duratek sees Q4 processsing resumption.

text.p: GTS Duratek Inc said Monday it estimates it will resume processing of radioactive waste at the U.S. Energy Department's Savannah River site in Georgia by the end of the fourth quarter of 1997.
As previously announced, the company suspended operations at its M-Area processing plant to make repairs and modifications, including the replacement of the melter box.
Once processing is resumed, Chief Financial Officer Robert F. Shawver said, the contracted processing will take six to nine months.
